parallel_transition_note: R059L first counts distinguishable proof tokens, then divides by product T(x,y)! to recover raw packet-sequence histories. This mirrors the external edge-distinct versus node-distinct normalization without granting external ontology.
root_convention_note: R059L defines TAU_r directly by token-level last exits oriented toward endpoint root r. External sources may phrase arborescence orientation/rooting differently; the compared numerical determinant normalization matches the R059L root factor after translation.
self_loop_note: R059L self-loops enter d_x and the denominator but cannot be non-root last-exit arborescence arcs; the external determinant diagonal removes a_uu from the arborescence part while its factorial formula still includes multiplicity.

relevant_external_statements: Directed multigraph adjacency multiplicities a_uv may exceed 1 and self-loops a_uu>0 are allowed.
For source s,target t, r_u=d+(u) for u!=t and r_t=d+(t)+1.
Node-distinct trail count is det(L) * product_u(r_u-1)! / product_{u,v} a_uv!.
The multi-edge factorial denominator removes permutations of parallel edges so only node-distinct trails are counted.
sources.title: Beyond the BEST Theorem: Fast Assessment of Eulerian Trails

relevant_external_statements: BEST relates directed Eulerian trails to arborescences and local outgoing-edge permutations.
For directed multigraphs, edge-distinct and node-distinct trail notions differ; node-distinct means different node sequences.
sources.title: Optimal Enumeration of Eulerian Trails in Directed Graphs
